# The Institution Hidden Inside the Contract — finished platform kit

## 1. LONG VIDEO
Begin with the Butterick fashion sheet and ask how many agreements sit behind one visible output. Build the institution across four rooms: before, during, control, after. Use public SEC employment agreements to show that duties, reporting, authority, term, and termination can live in different clauses. Finish by running a collaboration through seven failure scenarios.

## 2. SHORT 01
“The ownership clause is not the whole institution.” Flash: scope, approver, revision, payment, credit, source files, license, archive, exit. End: a contract is a workflow with consequences.

## 3. SHORT 02
“If the contract says ‘work made for hire’ and stops there, the analysis may not be finished.” Ask who created the work, employment status, statutory category, signed transfer, territory, and retained rights. Counsel must review the actual facts.

## 4. CAROUSEL
1: THE CONTRACT IS AN OPERATING SYSTEM. 2: PARTIES / AUTHORITY. 3: INPUTS. 4: DELIVERABLES. 5: APPROVAL. 6: MONEY. 7: OWNERSHIP / LICENSE. 8: CREDIT. 9: FILES / RECORDS. 10: TERMINATION. 11: TRANSITION / ARCHIVE. 12: DISPUTE / COUNSEL.

## 5. NEWSLETTER
Subject: The clause you negotiate is the institution you will inhabit. Tell the story of one collaboration from reference folder to archive, showing the point where each clause changes a human action. Include the before/during/control/after audit.

## 6. COLLABORATOR EDITION
Opening copy: “Before we discuss ownership, let us identify what each person brings, makes, approves, receives, may reuse, must preserve, and can still explain after the relationship ends.” Follow with the eight-scenario negotiation worksheet.

## Claim ledger
- **VERIFIED:** Public SEC exhibits show that agreements can allocate title, duties, reporting lines, decision authority, term, compensation, and termination consequences. (S50, S51)
- **VERIFIED:** Copyright ownership and transfers may also turn on whether work qualifies as made for hire and whether an executed writing transfers rights. (S53, S54, S55, S57)
- **INFERENCE:** The institution hidden inside a contract is the operating system created by many clauses acting together, not a single ownership sentence. (S50, S51, S52, S55)

## Publication discipline
Do not invent production arrangements or add unlicensed imagery. Preserve captions, alt text, creator and institution credits, canonical URLs, evidence labels, labor and jurisdiction limits, participant correction, and counsel or specialist gates.
